spine: Bind reliance to a scoped claim, follow failures across four system layers, and renew the evidence after change.
art: An assurance testing bay: a working assembly survives specified fault tests, a changed component invalidates its old certificate, and explicit human escalation holds unresolved work.
lines: Trustworthy AI teaches how to justify reliance on an entire deployed system.
It connects reliability, fairness, security, and human oversight through explicit assurance claims.
The central question is what evidence supports a particular use under stated conditions.
A model score cannot answer that question alone.
Readers learn how to make confidence inspectable, bounded, and renewable when systems change.
